release_notes: Ban 0.0.38: hoan tat quy hoach ma nguon theo huong phat trien lau dai — 36 module duoc chia vao 5 goi: core/ (du lieu, luu tru, bao mat, tien ich), auth/ (phien va dang nhap cong), gdt/ (cong hoa don dien tu), dvc/ (cong dich vu cong, to khai), services/ (sao luu, PDF, nhap tep, bao cao, email). Diem vao app.py, build.py va updater.py giu o goc. Khong thay doi chuc nang; da chay lai toan bo 312 test, kiem ma, quet bao mat nghiem ngat va khoi dong thu ban dong goi 10 giay de xac nhan dong goi dung.
